note: Example overlay, not the real one. An overlay is the only file that may name a private source: Continuum is public, so the committed ledger carries public sources and an operator-supplied overlay adds the private ones. The repository below is a placeholder; the real overlay is not committed and is passed with --overlay or CONTINUUM_PARITY_LEDGER_OVERLAY. Sources here are read only with the least-privilege credential in CONTINUUM_PARITY_PRIVATE_TOKEN, and their repository, paths, and commit metadata are redacted from every published artifact.

sources.note: A private automation repository this installation tracks. Reached only through a configured least-privilege credential; without one it is reported unavailable and every public source is still audited.

paths.note: Publication and idempotence properties Continuum holds.
